label: D2: a2 chosen but rare transition to S1, after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO), almost always when the agent chose a2 and the rare transition took it to S1 (a2->S1 rare holds 94% of activation mass; F1 0.32 because only about 20% of such steps are active). Adding that the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward == 0, which the agent saw at this trial D1) raises precision to 0.42 and keeps 89% of the mass; this predicate covers 99% of the top-quartile activations. Weak activations also occur on other D2 steps (common a2->S2, a1->S1), which make up most of the missed activations but little of the mass. Activation is stronger late in the episode (ep_trial 50-89) and when the model value is low (5.2-7.5). It never fires after a rewarded input. Every variable used is observed by D2, so this is not a future predicate. Restricting to good == S1 raises precision to 0.61 but loses half the mass, so the feature does not cleanly track the hidden good state. Recall and precision are both incomplete, which suggests magnitude is also shaped by a slower context such as the agent belief or recent a2 history.
